summary: Learn how AI transforms customer experience management. Join our training course to master innovative strategies and improve client engagement today!
lede: AI for customer insights applies customer data and service interactions to understand journey friction and evaluate service outcomes. For customer experience managers, contact centre leaders, and CRM specialists, the practical task is prioritizing AI use cases across customer journeys and service workflows. Training covers data-readiness assessment, NPS, CSAT, CES and first-contact resolution measurement, interaction classification, human escalation design, and consent and customer-risk controls.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who shape customer journeys, service operations, CRM workflows, and AI adoption decisions. It suits intermediate practitioners who can work with customer data and operational metrics but do not need programming experience.
prerequisites: You should have working experience in customer experience, customer service, contact centre operations, CRM, service design, customer analytics, or digital transformation. Familiarity with NPS, CSAT, customer journeys, and basic service-performance reporting is recommended. No coding or programming is required. Advanced AI model engineering, software development, and production deployment are introduced conceptually rather than taught as implementation skills. Bring a laptop if you want to adapt the digital templates to your own CX environment.
